per_candidate.id: s2:Relativistic Aspects of Accreting Supermassive Black Hole Binaries in Their Natu

rationale: Paper 2209.14509 discusses the delay time of supermassive black hole binary mergers, which is directly related to the timescales of formation and coalescence. Paper 2003.13789 provides simulations of the orbital decay of massive black hole pairs, contributing evidence on the coalescence process. Together, they provide substantive new evidence on parts of the question, but do not fully settle it.
